plans.goal: wall off the wolves with fire and keep everyone behind the barricade
steps: set the gorse ablaze to create a fire barrier between us and the pack
hold the fold wall as a strongpoint and keep Maud safe inside
use the campfire as a second line of defense

atoms.text: Fire the gorse before the gate—that wall of flame keeps them at bay while we regroup
Everyone falls back to the fold wall—Borin and I hold the gap, Maud stays at the center
Maud, stay in the middle of the fold where you can see and heal—nothing gets in here
Pip, watch the east side of the fold—if a wolf tries to circle around the fire, stop it
I'm ready at the gap—if the fire burns down, we use the campfire to hold them back
If anyone gets close to the wall, Borin and I shove them back into the fire

plans.goal: use the fold wall and terrain to split the pack and defeat them piecemeal
steps: knock the fold wall over to crush the Gaunt wolf and create a new barrier
spread the pack's attention across multiple fronts
coordinate hits on each wolf while they're separated

atoms.text: Heave the fold wall over—it crushes and creates a gap, leaving the Gaunt wolf pinned
Pip and Borin, take the Young wolf on the right—I'm moving to the Scarred one in the middle
Maud, you're with the fallen logs as cover—heal whoever needs it, stay safe back there
Borin, hold the line by the logs—don't let any wolf get past you to Maud
The Gaunt wolf is already hurting—Pip, once you finish the Young one, we all pile on it

plans.goal: aggressive defense—use fire and our bodies to drive the pack away from the fold
steps: position ourselves between the wolves and the sheepfold
use fire sparingly to scare, not to trap ourselves
push forward and drive them north, away from the livestock

atoms.text: We're moving out in front of the fold—between the wolves and the sheep, we're the only thing they see
Borin on the left, me in the center, Pip on the right—Maud is well back healing and watching
If we're getting overwhelmed, I use fire to back them up, not to burn the fold down
Pip, circle the Scarred wolf—once you're behind it, we all hit it at once
If they get too close to Maud or the fold, we fall back and regroup—holding the fold is the mission
Every wolf we push is one that's not near the sheep—shove and drive them to the gates
